title: British Museum collection record for Oc1899,170

notes.text: The BM production-place field qualifies Easter Island as “in style of”, while its combined findspot/acquisition field is uncertain between the Society Islands and Easter Island. This does not establish production on Rapa Nui. The catalogue labels this combined field “Found/Acquired”; it is retained as source wording and is not treated as an independently established findspot. A separate “Production place” field is represented as made_at when present.
